description: K₃NaTh₂O₆ is beta Sn-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted KO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four ThO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with four ThO₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent KO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-18°. There are two shorter (2.70 Å) and four longer (2.95 Å) K-O bond lengths. In the second K site, K is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted KO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four ThO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with four ThO₆ octahedra, and edges with six KO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-17°. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.76-2.97 Å. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six KO₆ octahedra, edges with six KO₆ octahedra, and edges with six ThO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-18°. There are four shorter (2.64 Å) and two longer (2.65 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Th sites. In the first Th site, Th is bonded to six O atoms to form ThO₆ octahedra that share corners with six KO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent ThO₆ octahedra, and edges with six KO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-14°. There are four shorter (2.35 Å) and two longer (2.36 Å) Th-O bond lengths. In the second Th site, Th is bonded to six O atoms to form ThO₆ octahedra that share corners with six KO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent ThO₆ octahedra, and edges with six KO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-14°. All Th-O bond lengths are 2.35 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three K, one Na, and two Th atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OK₃NaTh₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-12°. In the second O site, O is bonded to three K, one Na, and two Th atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OK₃NaTh₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-12°. In the third O site, O is bonded to three K, one Na, and two Th atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OK₃NaTh₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°.
